ACT IX OF 1992
ACT
IX OF 1992
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the
Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 19th September, 1992]
No. Legis. 2(3)/92/54, dated
19-9-1992.--The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1992, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 13th day of
September, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 15th day
of September, 1992, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Addition of section 4-A in Act XXX of 1975

ACT IX OF 1992
ACT
IX OF 1992
LAHORE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the
Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 19th September, 1992]
No. Legis. 2(3)/92/54, dated
19-9-1992.--The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1992, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 13th day of
September, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 15th day
of September, 1992, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab.
2. Addition of section 4-A in Act XXX of 1975.--In the Lahore
Development Authority Act, 1975 (XXX of 1975), hereinafter referred to as the
said Act, after section 4, the following section 4-A shall be added:--
"4-A.
Vice-Chairman.- (1) The Government may designate a member as Vice-Chairman of
the Authority.
(2) The
Vice-Chairman shall perform such functions as may be assigned to him by the
Authority".

Amendment of section 7 of Act XXX of 1975

An Act further to amend the
Lahore Development Authority Act, 1975
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 19th September, 1992]
No. Legis. 2(3)/92/54, dated
19-9-1992.--The Lahore Development Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1992, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 13th day of
September, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 15th day
of September, 1992, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab.
3. Amendment of section 7 of Act XXX of 1975.--(1) In the said Act,
in section 7, for subsection (2) the following shall be substituted:--
"(2) The
meetings of the Authority shall be presided over by the Chairman and in his absence
by the Vice-Chairman and in the absence of both by a member of the Authority
elected for the purpose by the members present, from amongst themselves."
